**Date:** Wednesday 11 November 2026  
**Time:** 14:00 - 15:30  
**Venue:** QT Perth, Murray Room

## Summary

The AAGI Partners session highlights the contributions and perspectives of AAGI's partner organisations. Speakers will share their work, priorities and opportunities to collaborate across the Australian grains innovation ecosystem.
